messages:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-47821 created for Acme Telemetry — total $45,320.70 (usage). Link: https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-47821

maria (Finance): Acme flagged this — they say their committed tier should have capped overage after 8/12 deployment. :eyes:

tom (Billing): Can you paste their support thread or the exact cap clause?

sasha (Acct Exec): They uploaded the contract excerpt in the CS ticket: committed tier = 120M tokens/mo; we billed 172M tokens. Customer claims platform burst caused extra tokens during the 8/11 sampling change.

emma (Customer Success): Confirmed — customer sent logs. They show a spike 2024-08-11 03:20–03:55 UTC from a misrouted batch job. They asked for a goodwill/manual adjustment.

maria (Finance): Preliminary calc: overbilled units = 52M tokens -> ~$12,450 at their blended rate. Asking for manual credit and invoice reissue.

tom (Billing): Need approval code and GL entry. Proposed journal: CRD-ACME-20240812, GL account 4102, reason = "mid-quarter tier cap rollback (platform burst)".

cory (Finance Lead): +1 to goodwill credit but want to keep precedent limited. Approve $12,450 credit if engineering confirms root cause and we add a one-time note on the invoice.

emma (Customer Success): Passed to eng-runtime for RCA and a short note for the customer explaining the credit and mitigation steps.

maria (Finance): OK I'll create credit memo and reissue INV-47821 -> INV-47821-R. Tom, can you post the journal entry after you make the adjustment?

tom (Billing): Will do. I'll also tag this as "one-time goodwill" in billing system and attach CS thread.

sasha (Acct Exec): I'll notify Acme that we're issuing the credit and will add details about the mitigation. Thanks all. :+1:

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-7691 created for INV-47821-R amount $12,450.00 (status: pending).
